_provenance: Transcribed twice, blind, from 45 Richemont results and sales announcements (Sep 2015 - Jul 2026) downloaded from richemont.com; 6,496 cells agreed, 4 disagreed (all on an unused cash line). One April-December table both extractors skipped (FY22) was found by a regex row census and transcribed by hand; every column closes on regions, channels and business areas. Quarter values are taken from the LATEST document that prints the quarter; five quarters were never printed and are derived; four cannot be separated from a five-month period.
